info.title: codemetr-csharp - C# code metrics per class and member, as a quality guard for local runs and CI
info.description: codemetr-csharp command line: C# code metrics per class and member as JSON, with a guard and ratchet baseline for local runs and CI.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: [PATH...] [options]   metrics of every type, plus violations (exit 0 unless input error)

commands.name: baseline
commands.description: record current violations as tolerated debt (ratchet)

commands.name: check
commands.description: [PATH...] [options]   guard: exit 1 on new/worsened violations or a stale baseline

options.name: --root
options.description: base for relative paths, codemetr.json and codemetr.baseline.json (default: current directory)

options.name: --type
options.description: only types with this simple name, full name or full-name suffix

options.name: --files-from
options.description: additional file list, one path per line ('-' = stdin); missing and non-.cs entries are skipped

options.name: --config
options.description: rules file (default: ROOT/codemetr.json if present, else built-in defaults)

options.name: --include-metrics
options.description: check: include per-type metrics in the report

options.name: --mutation-report
options.description: import a Stryker mutation-testing-elements v1/v2 JSON report (advisory)

options.name: --top
options.description:
number of hotspots in the report (default: 10)
Exit codes: 0 passed, 1 findings, 2 input or usage error.
